nodes.label: TeamPanel Implementierungsplan V1 (Roadmap)
nodes.rationale: Based on spec paragraphs 70/71, adjusted per E-26; each phase follows paragraph 90 and ends with a paragraph 91 checkpoint.

nodes.label: Phase 0 - Repository-Fundament
nodes.rationale: Empty but production-ready scaffold so every later phase can immediately add migrations, tests and UI; no business logic. Completed 2026-10-19.

nodes.label: Phase 3 - Rollen und Berechtigungen
nodes.rationale: No feature module starts before the scope matrix is green in pgTAP (spec: no further large feature before RBAC works).

nodes.label: Phase 6 - Notifications und Dashboard-Framework
nodes.rationale: Notifications pulled forward; widgets arrive with each module.

nodes.label: Phase 14 - PWA
nodes.rationale: Clock-in requires online connection; service worker caches only the app shell, no API data.

nodes.label: Toolchain (Node 22, pnpm 10, Vite 8, React 19, TypeScript 6.0)
nodes.rationale: TypeScript 7 and ESLint 10 deliberately not used: typescript-eslint supports TS only up to 6.0, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y ESLint only up to 9.

nodes.label: Architekturregel teampanel/layers
nodes.rationale: Enforces layers app -> modules -> platform -> components -> lib; feature modules never import each other; unknown src folders fail-closed.

nodes.label: Design-Token-Lint-Regel (src/styles/tokens.css)
nodes.rationale: Tailwind default palette removed; palette and arbitrary colors are reported by lint.

nodes.label: Env-Schema (src/lib/env-schema.ts, Allowlist)
nodes.rationale: Allowlist accepts only sb_publishable_ keys or anon JWT and explicitly rejects secret/service_role keys; checked at build and app start.

nodes.label: Baseline-Migration 20261019150258_baseline.sql (Default Privileges)
nodes.rationale: New tables/sequences/functions in public grant nothing to anon/authenticated; schema private not exposed; deliberately no citext (E-38).

nodes.label: DB-Guardrails (000_guardrails.test.sql, pgTAP)
nodes.rationale: Automatically apply to every future migration: RLS on all tables, no FOR ALL policies, security_invoker views, SECURITY DEFINER with empty search_path.

nodes.label: CI Workflow ci.yml (quality, database, e2e, security)
deploy-database.yml (Dry-Run, dann Apply)
nodes.rationale: Manual only, default branch only, green CI only; production applied after approval with visible dry-run.

nodes.label: RPC create_organization()
nodes.rationale: Atomically creates organization, system roles, owner membership, default modules and Free subscription mirror.

nodes.label: RPC absences_in_scope
nodes.rationale: Shows colleagues absences without type so sensitive leave types are not recognizable.

nodes.label: E-26: Phasenreihenfolge der Spec hat Luecken
